checkpoint: bounded navigation/layout/session workers and split workspaces

environment.sources: 41 temporary cached upstream substitutions; unchanged 266-package version/dependency graph; portable lock restored after building
environment.build: release, thin LTO, one codegen unit
environment.renderer: Ratatui TestBackend; shared host; scheduling/caches uncontrolled
environment.qualification_overlap: Final timing processes ran after local gates, builds and the PTY smoke; shared-host scheduling/caches remain uncontrolled.

comparison: Same executable and fixture, synchronous and background paths; admission includes a placeholder frame for background work; completed latency includes ready text and a second frame.

workloads.ordinary: 2000 articles, 8 smart lists, 320 navigations per mode, 40 bursts of 200 latest-only requests, 40 Study/guide/undo cycles
workloads.reflow: 160 width changes per process; 7248/72336 source bytes, Rust code fences, 20/200 private notes; exact source and selected bytes checked after every completion
workloads.compact: 40 actual fullscreen grip captures and drags per process; card cell budget and all visible rounded corners checked; timed two runtime frames; ordinary/stress pane fixtures

limitations: Not physical key-to-paint latency; no constant-latency claim.
Process wall time and peak RSS include setup; allocation counts are not measured.
Source-bound jumps, personal mutations and catalog reload/counts retain synchronous paths.
Pre-edit navigation baseline uses 98 sources/46 lists and differs from the new paired fixture; it is not a direct speedup comparison.
Completion uses yield-based polling; terminal runtime 16 ms wake cadence and physical transport/paint are excluded.
